sloka: कालातिक्रमणाच्चैव भक्तवेतनयोर्भृता: ।भर्त्तु: कुप्यन्ति दुष्यन्ति सो ऽनर्थ: सुमहान् स्मृत: ॥ २.१००.३४॥
transliteration: kālātikramaṇāccaiva bhaktavetanayorbhṛtā: ।bharttu: kupyanti duṣyanti so 'nartha: sumahān smṛta: ॥ 2.100.34॥

translations.english: I hope all men of a good family, especially those who belong to our race, are loyal to you and are ready to sacrifice their lives for your cause.
